notes.example: Rách nhẹ vạt dưới, đã sửa 06/2026

categoryId.description: Category id; omit = keep, explicit null = clear the assignment

dressCode.description: The dress code that is already in use

name.example: Váy cưới đuôi cá ren trắng

photoUrls.description: Photo links (staff-pasted; no upload in MVP)

categoryId.description: Category id (0..1 per dress; null = unclassified). Names come from GET /categories — a tiny cached list, so the FE joins client-side instead of every dress row carrying the name.

dressCount.description: How many dresses still hold the category (rejected_category_in_use)
How many dresses hold this category

price.description: Agreed price in VND (integer); omit to use the dress standard price

depositRefund.description: Deposit amount handed back to the customer, in VND (integer)

expectedDepositCollected.description: The deposit total the client computed its refund from. When present the server verifies it against the ledger under the rental row lock and refuses a settlement whose basis moved (FR-PAY-02).

note.example: Rách nhẹ đường viền, đã thoả thuận phí

reason.description: Why the denial happened — only set for status=forbidden

suggestedLateFee.description: Late fee the shop should charge, so the UI can state the number (FR-RENT-09)

submittedLateFee.description: Late fee the client tried to charge

collectedDeposit.description: Deposit currently on file, so the screen can re-derive the refund it offered (rejected_deposit_basis_changed, FR-PAY-02)

blockedUntilDate.description: Last day the dress is blocked, cleaning buffer included (inclusive)

available.description: True when booking [startDate, endDate] would succeed — the cleaning buffer is included and a retired dress is never available

conflicts.description: Blocking bookings that overlap the asked period extended by the cleaning buffer (empty when available)

depositAmount.description: The catalog STANDARD deposit for this dress in VND — a reference figure. What was actually collected is the `deposit` total of GET /rentals/:id/payments (FR-PAY-02)

agreedPrice.description: The price agreed with THIS customer for this dress in VND (rental_items.price), which may differ from the catalog price

date.description: The date the board was computed for

dueOut.description: Booked rentals starting on the date — dresses to hand out

dueBack.description: Not-yet-returned rentals ending on the date — dresses coming back

overdue.description: Not-yet-returned rentals whose last day is already past

referenceDate.description: The shop's calendar day used for the quote

daysLate.description: Calendar days after dueDate; 0 when on time

dressCount.description: Dresses in the rental — the fee is per dress

dailyRateAmount.description: VND per dress per day (shop configuration)

rentalFee.description: Rental fee actually collected, in VND (integer ≥ 1)

note.description: Written onto every movement this call records

recordedAmount.description: The amount already on file for that kind (rejected_*_already_recorded)

createdByName.description: Name of the staff member who created it, resolved at read time (FR-QR-03). Null when that account no longer exists.
